summary: Proof of concept on the rollo toy set with the BatchNorm MLP encoder, 30 seeds, rules pre-registered before each run (Notebooks/PoC_Hypotheses_Rollo.ipynb, run 3). Task-level adaptation is supported; attention with consensus down-weights artifact-like contamination; the local term (K2) shows no gain and the K3 ladder is ordered as expected but not significant. Corrected run (Results/PoC_K2K3): task beats the BN-matched floor; K2 inconclusive (local correspondence near uniform); K3 not supported. EEG experiments have not run.

hypotheses.statement: Contaminated windows receive less attention weight than clean ones, more so than without consensus.
hypotheses.metric: attention-mass contrast c on contaminated vs clean windows
hypotheses.criterion: pre-registered rule: every contrast of the family with (Holm-adjusted) p < 0.05
hypotheses.rationale: Validated with artifact contamination (off-manifold, as EEG artifacts); fails at 10% donor-class contamination.

hypotheses.statement: The local term aligns each target bag with its compatible source partner beyond the global term.
hypotheses.criterion: pre-registered rule: every contrast of the family with (Holm-adjusted) p < 0.05
hypotheses.observed: K2a supported (p_Holm<1e-8); K2b gate failed: median pi entropy ratio 0.987 (>=0.9), partner kernel rank at start 0.062 (<0.5)
hypotheses.rationale: The local correspondence is near uniform and partners are not kernel-nearest at the start of phase 2, so the local term had no room to separate partners; pre-registered verdict: inconclusive (mechanism had no room).

hypotheses.statement: Both adaptation terms together beat each alone, and the consensus beats its no-consensus variant.
hypotheses.criterion: pre-registered rule: every contrast of the family with (Holm-adjusted) p < 0.05
hypotheses.observed: K3a (artifact) p=0.235; K3c p_Holm 0.253 clean / 0.161 artifact; K3b inconclusive (same gate as K2b). Means clean TGL 0.848, TG 0.843, TL 0.822, TGL-NC 0.813.
hypotheses.rationale: Under the corrected families (Holm per table) the gaps go in the expected direction but none is significant; K3c had room (routing error 0.667), so its result is a real non-support on the toy set.

qualitative.title: Attention under artifact contamination
qualitative.reading: Artifacts receive less weight than clean windows at every rate.

limitations: Toy-set evidence only; no EEG campaign has run.
Comparators are not part of the PoC, so ranking claims are untested here.
next_steps: Discuss K2 and K3 before the full EEG run.
Place the full run with the timing probe and plan before launching.

novelty.claim: Unsupervised bag-level adaptation of subject-level EEG diagnosis to unlabeled target bags (relevance- and consensus-weighted bag kernel, class-conditional Rényi global alignment, subject-level local alignment).
novelty.rationale: The novelty comparison is against the eight comparators on EEG, which runs only in the full experiments; the PoC supports adaptation over the source-only floor on the toy set.
